Governments / Universities / Statutory / Autonomous Bodies or Research and Development Organizations:i. Holding analogous posts on regular basis, ORii. salary_details.details: The deputation will be governed by the standard terms and conditions of deputation provided under Department of Personnel & Training’s O.M.No.6/8/2009-Estt. (Pay II) dated 17.06.2010, as amended from time to time.

selection_process: The selection process consists of short-listing of candidates based on bio-data
followed by an interview for short-listed candidates.
how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application format (Performa as Annexure – A) from the official website.
Fill in all required details correctly in the application form.
Attach attested copies of all relevant certificates and documents.

Ensure the application is forwarded through the proper channel along with required enclosures including attested copies of Confidential Reports, Vigilance Clearance Certificate, Latest Salary Slip, statement of minor/major penalties, and integrity certificate.
Super scribe the envelope as “Application for the post of ………………………….…... on deputation basis”.
Send the application by Speed Post or Registered Post ONLY to “Recruitment Cell, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Rishikesh, Uttarakhand, Pin-249203” on or before 08-11-2026.
important_instructions: Any number of vacancies can be decreased or cancelled before or after interview without assigning reasons. The period of deputation shall be initially for 2 years as per DoPT norms / Govt. of India rules. Experience and age will be calculated by the last date to receive application forms i.e. 08.11.2026. Applications received without proper channel and without vigilance clearance or attested copies of CR Dossiers will not be considered. Prescribed qualifications are minimum requirements and do not automatically make candidates eligible for selection. Original documents must be produced at the time of selection/interview as proof of details furnished.
